newsitem.title: USA: InaCom sees Q4 charge on acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: InaCom sees Q4 charge on acquisitions.

text.p: InaCom Corp said Monday it had agreed to acquire three network consulting firms: Perigee Communications Inc of Minneapolis; Networks Inc of Fort Lauderdale, Fla., and Gorham Clark of New York.

InaCom said it would pay a total of about $10.5 million cash and issue about 360,000 common shares in the three separate deals, with a potential issuance of 120,000 more shares contingent on future events.
Costs and expenses in connection with the transactions will result in a non-recurring fourth-quarter after-tax charge of $1.0 to $1.25 million, InaCom said.
Gorham was acquired in a purchase, while Perigee and Networks were acquired in transactions accounted for as poolings of interests, InaCom said.
InaCom is a technology management services company.
